answer: The ocean schedule is applied in quill and vault shows each instalment. A payout is split so that 58% arrives at settlement and the rest over 11 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. An adversary therefore cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 4676 identities would post 3848 proofs and burn roughly 76 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
